parameters.prompt:
Extract the following information from this website:

1. Business name
2. Main services or products offered (list up to 5)
3. Target audience/customer type
4. Geographic areas served
5. Key benefits or unique selling points
6. Industry/sector
7. Any pricing information mentioned

Provide the information in clear, structured format.

values.content:
=You are a Google Ads campaign architect specializing in lead generation for South African businesses.

CLIENT INFORMATION:
Business: {{ $('Normalize Client Data').item.json.account_name }}
Website: {{ $('Normalize Client Data').item.json.website_url }}
Target CPL: ${{ $('Normalize Client Data').item.json.target_cpl }}
Weekly Budget: ${{ $('Normalize Client Data').item.json.weekly_budget }}
Client Wishes: {{ $('Normalize Client Data').item.json.client_wishes }}

WEBSITE ANALYSIS:
{{ $json }}

YOUR TASK: Generate a complete Google Ads Search campaign structure.

REQUIREMENTS:

1. CAMPAIGN BASICS:
   - Campaign name: "[Business Name] - Lead Gen - Search"
   - Daily budget: {{ $('Normalize Client Data').item.json.weekly_budget / 7 }} (weekly budget / 7)
   - Bidding: Target CPA set to {{ $('Normalize Client Data').item.json.target_cpl }}
   - Network: Search only
   - Locations: South Africa (or specific cities if mentioned in website/wishes)
   - Language: English

2. KEYWORDS (30-50 TRANSACTIONAL ONLY):
   - Generate keywords based on services, location, and buying intent
   - ONLY transactional keywords (hire, buy, service, company, agency, professional, near me, best, top, quote, price)
   - Mix of EXACT and PHRASE match types
   - Focus on South African context (include location modifiers)
   - Examples:
     * [marketing agency johannesburg] (EXACT)
     * "hire marketing company" (PHRASE)
     * [digital marketing services south africa] (EXACT)
   
3. NEGATIVE KEYWORDS (30-50):
   - Informational queries: what is, how to, guide, tips, tutorial, free, learn, course, training
   - Job seekers: job, jobs, career, careers, vacancy, hiring, employment, CV, resume
   - DIY/self-service: diy, yourself, template, example, sample
   - Competitors (if identifiable)
   - Low-value: cheap, free, intern, student
   
4. AD GROUPS (5-10 maximum):
   - Group keywords by service/product theme
   - Each ad group should have 5-10 related keywords
   - Names: "[Service Name] - [Location if relevant]"
   - Examples:
     * "Digital Marketing Services - Johannesburg"
     * "SEO Services - South Africa"
     * "Social Media Management"

5. ADS (3 Responsive Search Ads per ad group):
   For EACH ad group, generate 3 RSAs with:
   - 15 headlines (max 30 chars each)
     * Include business name
     * Include service/benefit
     * Include location
     * Include CTAs
     * Include USPs from website
   - 4 descriptions (max 90 chars each)
     * Expand on benefits
     * Include pricing if available
     * Include CTAs
   - Final URL: {{ $('Normalize Client Data').item.json.website_url }}

6. OUTPUT FORMAT (JSON):
```json
{
  "campaign": {
    "name": "Campaign name here",
    "daily_budget_micros": 142857142857,
    "target_cpa_micros": 500000000,
    "location": "South Africa",
    "language": "en"
  },
  "negative_keywords": [
    {"text": "keyword", "match_type": "BROAD"},
    ...
  ],
  "ad_groups": [
    {
      "name": "Ad Group Name",
      "keywords": [
        {"text": "keyword", "match_type": "EXACT"},
        {"text": "keyword phrase", "match_type": "PHRASE"},
        ...
      ],
      "ads": [
        {
          "headlines": [
            "Headline 1",
            "Headline 2",
            ... (15 total)
          ],
          "descriptions": [
            "Description 1",
            "Description 2",
            ... (4 total)
          ],
          "final_url": "{{ $('Normalize Client Data').item.json.website_url }}"
        },
        ... (3 ads total)
      ]
    },
    ... (5-10 ad groups)
  ]
}
```

GENERATE THE COMPLETE CAMPAIGN STRUCTURE NOW.
